scope: Every Markdown page under career/ written before 2014 Week 6 (the close of Week 5, October 5, 2014), by path, with the sha256 digest of its bytes as it stood before Week 6 (recorded with rebuild step 3a, October 19, 2026, after that step's rebuild of the age views for the canon birth-date change). These pages are history under rebuild rule 1: a page is exempt from the clean-page check only while its bytes match its digest. "lengths" holds the length in bytes of each page as it stood before Week 6 (recorded with rebuild step 3b, October 19, 2026, from the same bytes, every page still matching its digest): an append-only page whose current bytes begin with exactly those bytes is checked only on the entries that follow them. A page rewritten from Week 6 on is checked like a new page; a page the player page builder writes is checked by its marker.
